points: Contributed to the development of a human-evaluated dataset for ranking AI-edited images generated by multiple AI models, building on the foundation of the ICVG project.
Labeled and verified over 8,000 AI-generated images for subject identity consistency across multiple reference inputs, maintaining a daily labeling accuracy rate of >95%.
Led Quality Alignment (QA) tasks by resolving annotation conflicts, ensuring final labels met strict accuracy and visual criteria.
Assessed image fidelity based on shape, color, texture, and compliance with formatting guidelines.
Scored generation outputs based on text-prompt alignment, context accuracy, and visual coherence.
Guided and mentored students in advanced mathematics topics, focusing on problem-solving techniques and strategies for competitive mathematics olympiad exams.
Prepared students for various stages of mathematics olympiad competitions, including national and international levels.
Successfully helped students achieve high rankings and accolades from gold medals.
